issues.title: Sign-up treats emails that differ only in case as different accounts
issues.body:
`accounts/signup.py:4`: `sign_up` checks and stores the email exactly as typed. Two emails that differ only in letter case sign up as two accounts.

Reproduction:

```python
from accounts.signup import sign_up
sign_up("Bob@shop.test", "h")
sign_up("bob@shop.test", "h")  # expected ValueError("this email has an account"); it returns a second account
```

A fix must normalize the email (for example `strip().lower()`) before the lookup and before the store, with a test that signs up `Bob@shop.test` and then `bob@shop.test`. Decide if the account keeps the email as typed for display.

Out of scope here: found in the review of the branch for #14, which changes only `orders/`.
